offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells automotive access control and security products such as locks, keys, latches, electronic access systems and door handles. Sells mainly to automakers as a tier-one supplier, plus aftermarket and non-automotive customers, with manufacturing in North America and Mexico.

primary_products.value: vehicle door latches; lock sets and keys; electronic access and keyless entry systems; door handles; liftgate and hood latches

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive OEMs such as Stellantis, GM, Ford, aftermarket locksmiths and dealers, recreational and commercial vehicle makers

end_markets.value: automotive; commercial vehicles; recreational vehicles; aftermarket locksmith

revenue_model.value: product sales: access control components and systems sold to automakers and aftermarket customers

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: manufactures locks, latches and access systems from purchased metals and electronics, sold to automakers; OEM / manufacturer: makes aftermarket keys and lock products sold via distributors

geography_served.value: North America: US, Canada and Mexico manufacturing and customers, with some sales to Asia and Europe via affiliates

specialization.value: related lines: locks and keys, latches, electronic access systems and door handles for vehicles

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: supply contracts with automotive OEMs and tier-one customers; distributors / dealers: aftermarket distributors and locksmith suppliers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle safety and anti-theft standards, environmental and trade rules such as USMCA tariffs
